# shopify_consent_policy (Resource)

What the shop requires from visitors in one country or region before collecting data. Use it when the shop runs its own consent banner: **Shopify refuses every write while its own cookie banner is on**, so turn it off first with `shopify_privacy_settings` (`cookie_banner_auto_managed = false`) and add `depends_on`. Every country and region already has a policy, Shopify's default until one is written, so create always takes the existing row over and writes only the configured values. Destroy only removes the resource from state: the row keeps its values, and the API can't return it to Shopify's default. Import with `<COUNTRY>` or `<COUNTRY>/<REGION>`, such as `DE` or `US/USCA`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `country_code` (String) Two-letter country code, such as `DE`.

### Optional

- `consent_required` (Boolean) Whether consent is required. Unset means not managed.
- `data_sale_opt_out_required` (Boolean) Whether data sale opt-out is required. Unset means not managed.
- `region_code` (String) Country code plus subdivision, such as `USCA` or `CAQC`; only US and Canadian regions exist. Unset manages the country-level policy.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Consent policy GID. Shopify's defaults have IDs like `SD-DE` until a policy is written, then the ID becomes numeric.
